### About

Full-Stack Engineer and Systems Architect based in Bangkok, Thailand, focused on resilient cloud backends, edge-first architectures, and precision web & native interfaces.

- **Architecture First:** Designing end-to-end systems from relational schemas, RBAC security boundaries, and serverless queues to hyper-fluid frontends.
- **Production Shipped:** Deployed multi-role enterprise platforms across Next.js 15, ASP.NET Core 10, Cloudflare Workers, Docker, and Neon Serverless Postgres.
